comment: How the page presents each release of the firmware: the name it goes by here, and a line about where it stands. A release that is not listed is shown by its own state on GitHub (verified, untested or draft). `pending` names what the page will list once its files are in a release.

release-2026-11-15.label: Alpha
release-2026-11-15.note: Validated on a unit through the night of 14 to 15 Nov 2026.

pending.label: Beta
pending.note: The current build. Its files are not in a release yet.
